title: Shakle ali ghazi mera
body:
Shakle ali ghazi mera
<<MINI>>
Shakle ali, ghazi mera, qaayam rahe, iski wafa (abbas alam tera, jo log uthayenge) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Zehra ki dua onke, saaye me woh aayenge
<<MINI>>
Shakle ali, ghazi mera, qaayam rahe, iski wafa (abbas alam tera, jo log uthayenge) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Tehreer hai dariya pe, ghazi ki wafaa dari. Shabbir tere munkar, kya isko mitaa yenge
